subject: Class 390 Pendolino (Alstom), Avanti West Coast: driving motor and the car behind it.
method: Body from the WestRail642fan Avanti 390/0 diagram, scaled along to the published car lengths (DM 25.1 m = 745 px: 29.68 px/m; car 2 697 px = 23.7 m: 29.4 px/m) and up to the published height (rail row 175, roof row 61 = 3.56 m: 32.0 px/m). The diagram's bogies are drawn with a 3.3 m wheelbase: the published 2.70 is used about the diagram's bogie centres. The nose and its head-on features are the pilot's (classes/electric.ts class390: an eye check, 19 checklist items done): not yet measured on a photo.

trace.model.cab: dia row 105: door 1 runs cols 253-287 (8.52-9.67 m, centre 9.10), saloon glass runs (192,192,192) as listed; bogie centres from the axle hubs on row 158 (90.5/189.5, 603.5/701.5 px).
trace.model.next: dia: car 2 from col 769: doors at cols 774-807 and 1427-1460, glass runs, axle hubs 812.5/910.5 and 1324.5/1422.5.
trace.model.heights: dia col 330: glass rows 98-116 (2.41-1.84), orange cantrail line row 78 (3.03), body foot row 143 (1.0).
trace.noseProfile: dia: the nose's leftmost pixel every 5 rows (x = col/29.68, y = (175 - row)/32.0). Recorded, not yet used: the pilot's nose profile (classes/electric.ts) is kept until the head-on features are re-measured with it.
trace.liveries.VT.branding: The Avanti bodyside graphic (words and the orange triangle, logos/VT.svg in its own colours) between the cab and door 1 on the cab car: p141 (390141, 2024), against door 1's edges and height (diagram 8.52-9.67 m, 1.06-2.94 m: 56 px/m along, 128 px/m up at the door): 5.5-7.8 m along, 1.25-2.54 m up. Approximate (±0.3 m along): no photo gives a square-on view of this panel with enough known edges.
trace.liveries.VT.branding.front: 'AVANTI WEST COAST' with the triangle in white on the black panel over the yellow chin (p111, 390141): its block 2757-2989 x 1575-1661 px; scaled by the headlamps' spacing (2553.6/3178.6 px for m ±0.87 from the p111 face solve: 359 px/m): centred on the centre line, 0.65 m wide, 0.24 tall, its middle 0.25 m above the headlamps (1.57) = 1.82 m. Approximate (the face's rake foreshortens heights).
